documents.title: NASA FY2024 Agency Financial Report
documents.rights_notes: NASA media guidelines apply; individual photographs and other third-party material can have separate rights. Keep source files local and review credits before publishing excerpts.

documents.title: Lucinda Davis Diary, 1874
documents.rights_notes: NPS marks the digital asset public domain and requests credit: Courtesy of North Cascades NPS Complex Museum Collection, Aerial Photograph Collection.
documents.inspection_notes: Pages 12, 35 and 74 visually verified as handwriting; page 5 contains a printed calendar/table. All 76 PDF pages have no text layer. This is historical handwriting by one writer, not a modern handwriting benchmark.

documents.title: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery (v3)
documents.rights_notes: CC BY 4.0, linked from the arXiv record. Credit Chris Lu, Cong Lu, Robert Tjarko Lange, Jakob Foerster, Jeff Clune, David Ha; identify modifications to extracted subsets.
documents.inspection_notes: Main paper includes a pipeline diagram and multi-panel plots; appendices include code-like text and AI-generated papers. Use for visual extraction only; scientific claims in generated appendices are not verified.
